paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept various payment methods for your convenience: Visa, Mastercard, Multibanco, MB WAY and PayPal. All payments are securely processed with SSL encryption to ensure your data protection.

booking.question: How can I book my trip?
booking.answer: Booking your trip is simple! Contact us through the form on the website, WhatsApp or phone. Our team will help you choose the best vehicle and time for your needs. We recommend booking in advance to ensure availability.

roundTrip.question: How does a round trip work?
roundTrip.answer: On a round trip, our driver takes you to your destination and waits for the agreed time to bring you back. You can enjoy your outing without worrying about transportation. The waiting time is flexible and can be adjusted according to your needs.

discount.question: What discount do I get for sharing a trip?
discount.answer: We offer attractive discounts for groups sharing the trip! The more people, the greater the individual discount. Contact us to receive a personalized quote based on the number of passengers and desired destination.

otherDestinations.question: Do you travel to other places?
otherDestinations.answer: Yes! We provide transfers to various destinations in Portugal and Spain. In addition to airports, we travel to tourist cities, special events, hotels and any other location you need. Ask us about your specific destination.

booking.question: How far in advance should I book?
booking.answer: We recommend booking at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. However, we accommodate same-day requests whenever possible. For peak season, holidays, or large group transfers, booking 48–72 hours ahead ensures the best vehicle selection.

flightDelay.question: What happens if my flight is delayed?
flightDelay.answer: We monitor every flight in real time. If your flight is delayed, your driver’s schedule adjusts automatically — no calls, no stress. There’s no extra charge for flight delays, and your chauffeur will be waiting when you land, regardless of the time.

private.question: Are all transfers truly private?
private.answer: Yes. Every booking is a private service — you will never share your vehicle with other passengers. Your chauffeur, your vehicle, your schedule. No exceptions.

vehicles.question: Which vehicles are available?
vehicles.answer: Our fleet includes Mercedes E-Class, S-Class, V-Class, and Sprinter vans. For larger groups, we offer minibuses and full-size coaches. Every vehicle is maintained to the highest standards with complimentary water, Wi-Fi, and child seats on request.

coverage.question: Do you cover all of Portugal?
coverage.answer: We operate across mainland Portugal, from the Algarve to Porto and everywhere in between. Airport transfers, city-to-city routes, and custom itineraries are all available. We also cover cross-border transfers to Spain upon request.

faqsPage.q5: How does a return trip work?

faqsPage.q6: Can I share the transfer and get a discount?
faqsPage.a6: Yes. If you share the transfer with other passengers, we offer 20% off per trip. The final price depends on the destination and number of passengers.

faqsPage.q10: Can I hire a private driver for the day?

faqsPage.q11: How far in advance should I book?
faqsPage.a11: We recommend booking as far in advance as possible to secure availability, especially in peak periods (weddings, summer, Web Summit, special events).

q1.question: What types of vehicles are available for weddings?
q1.answer: Our wedding fleet covers everything from elegant executive sedans for the couple to classic vintage cars, supercars, vans for the bridal party, and full coaches for guests. We curate the right combination for your day.

q2.question: How far in advance should I book?
q2.answer: We recommend booking 6 to 12 months in advance, especially during peak wedding season (May–October). Last-minute requests are welcome and we will always do our best to accommodate.

q3.question: Do vehicles come with a chauffeur?
q3.answer: Yes — every vehicle is provided with a fully trained, uniformed chauffeur. Discretion, punctuality, and elegance are standard. Self-drive is not available.

q4.question: Is there a minimum hire duration?
q4.answer: Wedding bookings typically start at 4 hours per vehicle, though shorter point-to-point transfers can be arranged. We will tailor the timing to your itinerary.

q5.question: Is there a maximum hire duration?
q5.answer: There is no fixed maximum. Multi-day bookings, full-weekend arrangements, and overnight requirements are all possible. Tell us your plans and we will design the schedule.

q6.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q6.answer: Visa, Mastercard, MB Way, Multibanco, PayPal, and bank transfer. International cards are accepted; payment is processed in EUR.

q7.question: What are the payment conditions?
q7.answer: We typically request a 30% deposit to confirm the booking, with the balance due before the wedding day. Bespoke terms are available for larger packages — discussed during the quote stage.

q1.question: Do I need a professional transport license?
q1.answer: Yes. To join the LuxMotion network, the company must hold a valid passenger transport license and drivers need a professional driver's permit. We handle the validation during onboarding.

q2.question: What is the selection process?
q2.answer: Four steps: in-person interview with the partner manager, documentation and insurance validation, training on the LuxMotion protocol, and account activation on the Dispatcher platform. It takes 2 to 3 weeks.

q3.question: How and when do I receive payments?
q3.answer: Weekly payouts, always on the same date. Choose bank transfer, MB Way, or PayPal. Every completed trip is logged automatically — no need to submit invoices.

q4.question: How does LuxMotion make money?
q4.answer: We charge a fixed booking commission to the end client, not the driver. The per-km price you receive is net. No hidden fees or variable deductions from your earnings.

q5.question: What sets LuxMotion apart from Uber or Bolt?
q5.answer: Bookings 24-48h in advance, clients from 4 and 5 star hotels, higher commissions, dedicated human support, and zero exclusivity. You can keep operating with other platforms in parallel.

q6.question: Is this a full-time job?
q6.answer: No. It's a business-to-business partnership. You set your own schedule, choose which bookings to accept, and manage your fleet however you prefer. LuxMotion guarantees minimum volume but does not require exclusivity.

q1.question: Do I need a professional transport license?

q2.question: What is the selection process?
